issues.legal_issue: A quasi-judicial officer’s erroneous order, without material indicating extraneous influence, gratification, or other misconduct, does not by itself justify departmental disciplinary proceedings.

Whether unexplained inordinate delay in issuing a chargesheet can, by itself, justify quashing it depends on the circumstances, including the department’s prior knowledge of the alleged misconduct and whether the allegations indicate extraneous influences or gratification.
